_doc: Lockfile vectors (spec §5.1). `lockfile` is the raw contents of job.py.lock; `valid` says whether a bundle holding it is valid; for valid ones, `builds_from_source` names the packages the machine would build from source, in lockfile order.

cases.lockfile:
version = 1
revision = 3
requires-python = ">=3.12"

[manifest]
requirements = [{ name = "pkg" }]

cases.case: registry package with hashed sdist and wheel
cases.lockfile:
version = 1
revision = 3
requires-python = ">=3.12"

[manifest]
requirements = [{ name = "pkg" }]

[[package]]
name = "pkg"
version = "1.0"
source = { registry = "https://pypi.org/simple" }
sdist = { url = "https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/pkg-1.0.tar.gz", hash = "sha256:a7db850025b95ded1eae8a46181a1a6c56c92c96f0e2b005d9ff8dc0210cab44", size = 216463 }
wheels = [
    { url = "https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/pkg-1.0-py3-none-any.whl", hash = "sha256:ab7ae7122974553370f0bdb919e1a960b2cd1bc1ef0276416d896db81c14582c", size = 69583 },
]
